subject: general
question: Guru Bipin Singh was a _________ dancer awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Guru Bipin Singh was a **Manipuri** dancer awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966. 
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a director, choreographer, and teacher of Manipuri dance.
 
• He was born on** 23 August 1918** into a Bishnupriya Manipuri Family.
 
• He is regarded as the **Father of Manipuri Dance**.
 
• He choreographed many dance dramas and solo dances and produced many students.
 
• Guru Bipin Singh won many awards such as : 
 
 
• Title of Hanjaba by the Maharaja of Manipur
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award,1966
 
• The Sharangdev fellowship by Sur Shringar Samsad
 
• Kalidas Samman by Madhya Pradesh Government
 
• Anamika Kala Sangam award, Kolkata
 
• Shiromani Puraskar by Asian Paints, Kolkata
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Sahitya Akademi Award** is a literary honour in India, which the Sahitya Akademi, India's National Academy of Letters, annually confers on writers of the most outstanding books of literary merit published in any of the **24 major Indian languages** such as **Telugu, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, English, Bengali, Punjabi,** and the **22 listed languages** in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution recognised by the Sahitya Akademi, New Delhi.
 
• Established in **1954**, the award comprises a plaque and a cash prize of **₹** **1,00,000**.
 
• The award's purpose is to recognise and promote excellence in **Indian writing and also acknowledge new trends**.
 
• The annual process of selecting awardees runs for the preceding **twelve months**.
 
• The plaque awarded by the Sahitya Akademi was designed by the Indian filmmaker **Satyajit** **Ray**.
